params.name: limit
params.description: number of results on the page

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset to start reading from

params.name: services
params.description: List of all services to read logs. Case insensitive.

params.name: from_date
params.description:
Show logs starting from this date. If not set, use the current date. 
If `to_date` was set, this field must have a valid value.
Expects `YYYY-MM-DD` format
required: false

params.name: to_date
params.description:
Show logs end date. If not set, use the current date. if `from_date` was set, this field must have a valid value.
Expects `YYYY-MM-DD` format"
